name: ingest-recipe
description: Two isolated readers transcribe the line strips of one recipe page in parallel, then a command watch runs the gate (P1-P6) over their files

branches.prompt: Read the recipe {{recipe}}. Its folder is content/recipes/{{recipe}}/. Read content/recipes/{{recipe}}/lines.json and every strip image content/recipes/{{recipe}}/strips/line-<i>.png it lists, then write your reading, steps and judgement notes to content/recipes/{{recipe}}/agent/scribe.json as your instructions describe. Write no other file.

Read the recipe {{recipe}}. Its folder is content/recipes/{{recipe}}/. Read content/recipes/{{recipe}}/lines.json and every strip image content/recipes/{{recipe}}/strips/line-<i>.png it lists, then write your transcription to content/recipes/{{recipe}}/agent/second.json as your instructions describe. Write no other file.
